---
title: "Getting Started"
---

If you're new to captain-hook, these pages form a single linear path. Read them in order and you'll go
from nothing to a working, tested hook firing in Claude Code. Every snippet is copy-pasteable and
every command runs through `uvx capt-hook …` (no install). When you want to *look something up*
instead of learning, switch to the [Reference](../reference/index.qmd).

Pick your entry point:

- To set up in one command, run `uvx capt-hook init` — see [Installation](installation.qmd).
- To let Claude do it, install the plugin and ask it to "set up captain hook" — see [Agent Skills](skills.qmd).
- To block one command in 5 minutes, jump straight to the [Quickstart](quickstart.qmd).
- To get the mental model first, read [How Hooks Work](../guide/how-it-works.qmd).
- To browse everything in one place, see the [Reference](../reference/index.qmd).
